resources.string: Bring your own DeepSeek key. When you ask, OpenStrap sends a summary of your recent data to DeepSeek and shows you its analysis and suggestions. Nothing is sent by itself.
That doesn\'t look like a DeepSeek key. It starts with %1$s and has no spaces.
Couldn\'t save the key on this phone.
Analysis runs only when you tap Analyse now.
Your last result, or a new one
When you tap Analyse now, OpenStrap sends the data below to %1$s, with your own key. Nothing is sent before that, and nothing in the background.
A summary of each of the last 30 days: sleep time and score, Recovery, HRV, resting heart rate, load and strain, steps (false steps removed) and Energy.
The last 14 nights in detail: bed and wake times, sleep stages, wake-ups.
The last 14 workouts: sport, duration, average and highest heart rate, load, and how far the heart rate dropped after.
Your averages, sleep need, daily targets, today\'s plan, a simple forecast, and your age and sex if you entered them.
Never sent: your name, email, location or routes, the strap\'s ID or address, or raw heart rate readings.
DeepSeek is a separate company with its own terms and privacy policy, and it bills your key. The answer is general wellness guidance from your own numbers, not medical advice.
Your key stays on this phone, encrypted with the phone\'s key store. It is not in backups and it stays when you forget the strap.
From an earlier day, %1$s. Tap Analyse now for a fresh one.
General wellness guidance from your own numbers, not medical advice. If something worries you, see a doctor.
The answer came back incomplete, so some parts are missing.
The answer wasn\'t in the expected form, so it is shown as written.
Tap Analyse now for an analysis of your last 30 days and what to do next.
The assistant works with your own DeepSeek key. Add it in the assistant\'s settings.
Nothing is sent while it is off. Turn it on in the assistant\'s settings.
Couldn\'t reach DeepSeek. Check your connection and try again.
DeepSeek doesn\'t accept this key (error 401). Check it or replace it in the assistant\'s settings.
The DeepSeek account has no balance (error 402). Top it up on DeepSeek\'s site.
Too many requests (error 429). Wait a minute and try again.
DeepSeek didn\'t answer within 60 seconds. Try again.
The answer came back empty or unreadable. Try again.
DeepSeek is busy or down right now. Try again later.
Not enough data yet: the assistant needs at least 3 days with sleep or steps.
Smart analysis of your last 30 days
